contractsSection.heading: Inspect the Enforcement Contracts Directly
contractsSection.intro: Prompts suggest behavior; schemas and policy manifests enforce it. Browse the sanitized reference contracts below (read directly from /contracts/*.json) or open the full repository on GitHub.

contracts.caption: Locks synthesis models to web_access: false and enforces explicit epistemic_class, evidence_refs, and UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE state preservation.
invariants: Every claim requires sha256 input_snapshot_sha256 & minItems: 1 evidence_refs
status enum explicitly preserves OBSERVED | UNKNOWN | UNAVAILABLE

contracts.caption: Pins Tantivy 0.26.2 + ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 (multilingual-e5-small), verifies SHA-256 Hugging Face blob hashes, and bans silent single-lane fallbacks.
invariants: lexical_only_fallback and model_provider_fallback hardcoded to false
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) with deterministic 5-key tie-break ordering
Verifies exact 40-char HF revision and 64-char SHA-256 blob hashes offline

contracts.caption: Separates design principles, human approval gates, implementation tokens, and excluded build noise so multi-agent workflows resist context rot.
invariants: File presence in repo never grants retrieval permission without layer match
HUMAN_VISUAL_GATE_OR_FROZEN_CONTRACT required before L3 implementation opens
Generic UI skills isolated to implementation_or_mapping_only or qa_only
